coverageContract.eligibleDefinition: Actual native solver instances admitted with at least8 futurepoints; constructors may legitimately never receive a query
coverageContract.executedDefinition: Actual future-point distance lookups in the owned solver contexts, including real batch work beyond the accepted serial prefix
coverageContract.changedDefinition: Actual mixed-hash lookup path executed. Hit counts are not additional avoided baseline scans: baseline already has a256-entry cache. Only fresh paired runtime and exact published outputs assess improvement.

@tscircuit/power-trace-expander.inventoryScope: Complete runtime src tree and source package.json, authenticated originalarchive; excludes tests/build/dependency outputs

resultPolicy: All42 original cases per candidate arm, fresh own AB pairs; all failures/timeouts retained. Official screens remain unchanged; exact frozen V3 is additive after the official clock. Supported PASS/UNKNOWN/FAIL remain separate; only matched qualified outputs support speed comparisons.
rawGeometryPolicy: Raw original input/output/traces/canonicalCJSON only in normal authenticated Actions artifacts; no public source fixtures or geometry logs.
